Look at the date section heading above the Groceries and Rent entries.

steps: Starting data: budget $100, period 11 Nov to 04 Dec; Groceries $40 one-off and Rent $20 monthly recurring, both on 13 Nov; today 14 Nov.

Look at the Rent row below the 13 November section and its 'Total: $20'.

Read the Minimum spent card: $5, 14 Nov, 'Unnamed expense'. Compare with the Maximum spent card: $40, 13 Nov, 'Food'.
